architecture_summary: Reuse existing hydrateCoordinator as the sole hydrate orchestration entry. Extend it for resume triggers. Keep src/store/progress.js as the client mirror. Do not introduce a second coordinator. UI progress branches are a separate slice that reads coordinator state only.

reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing coordinator already owns hydrate sequencing; introducing another mechanism would split SoT.
Resume triggers attach to the same coordinator rather than a new bus.
Per-view hydrate would duplicate ownership forbidden by the freeze.

architectural_constraints.constraint: Single hydrate orchestration SoT in hydrateCoordinator

slices.title: Hydrate coordination core
slices.responsibility: Keep a single coordinator as the hydrate SoT and extend it for the approved coordination invariant.
slices.architectural_intent: Reuse hydrateCoordinator; do not add a parallel orchestrator.
slices.required_behavior: All hydrate starts go through the coordinator; duplicate in-flight hydrates are coalesced.
slices.implementation_notes: Group T1+T2: same invariant, same module.
slices.completion_contract: Coordinator exposes a single entry used by bootstrap and resume; no second mechanism.

required_surfaces.structural_contract: Existing coordinator export remains the test-addressable hydrate seam.

slices.title: Cloud progress UI branches
slices.responsibility: Independent UI branches that display coordinator progress without owning hydrate.
slices.architectural_intent: UI reads coordinator state; does not start a second hydrate path.
slices.required_behavior: Progress UI reflects coordinator phases; failure stays honest.
invariants: UI is not a hydrate SoT
must_not_change: hydrateCoordinator public sequencing contract from SLICE-001
slices.implementation_notes: Independent of SLICE-001 writes except read-only consumption of coordinator state shape already present.
slices.completion_contract: Progress branches covered without calling a second hydrate helper.

required_surfaces.structural_contract: Host adapter registration / callable interface for coordinator progress; no hydrate ownership.

slices.title: Resume hydrate triggers
slices.responsibility: Wire resume triggers into the existing coordinator after core + UI seams exist.
slices.architectural_intent: Extend coordinator; do not add a resume-only orchestrator.
slices.required_behavior: Resume calls the same coordinator entry as bootstrap.
slices.implementation_notes: Depends on coordinator entry (001) and progress UI contract (002).
slices.completion_contract: Resume trigger tests fail closed if a second hydrate starter is introduced.

required_surfaces.structural_contract: New resume module exports a callable that will later invoke the existing coordinator entry.
Resume uses the same coordinator entry; scaffold may add a registration seam only.

consumed_semantics: requestHydrate is the sole hydrate entry for bootstrap and resume
coordinator in-flight join returns a control result, not an API failure
progress UI contract from SLICE-002 is display-only and must not own hydrate starts
incoming_failure_modes: IN_FLIGHT_JOIN_BY_BOOTSTRAP: resume/bootstrap joins an already in-flight coordinator hydrate and must still complete startup
CONTROL_RESULT_AS_FAILURE: put_in_flight / race control results must not be fail-closed as API errors by resume consumers
coordinator entry missing or second hydrate starter introduced
interaction_invariants: Resume bootstrap must join in-flight coordinator work rather than starting a parallel hydrate
Control / race results from the coordinator are not API fail-closed failures for SLICE-003
SLICE-002 progress mapping remains read-only under resume triggers

race_boundaries.detail: Bootstrap and visibility-resume may call requestHydrate while a hydrate is already in-flight; join the existing promise.
Stale generation control results must be ignored for fail-closed paths; they are race control, not transport failure.

lifecycle_boundaries.detail: Cold start may observe an already-running coordinator hydrate from a prior trigger.
Visibility resume must re-enter via the same coordinator entry without duplicating in-flight work.

required_composition_behavior: When resume bootstrap finds coordinator in-flight, join that promise and still complete startup readiness
Do not treat coordinator control results (in-flight join, stale generation) as fail-closed API failures
Resume must not bypass requestHydrate or invent a second hydrate starter beside SLICE-001

proof_placement.obligation: Resume calls the same coordinator entry; duplicate starter fails closed
Visibility resume joins in-flight hydrate and does not fail-closed on control results

invariant_classifications.invariant: Resume must join in-flight coordinator work and not invent a second starter
Coordinator control results are not API fail-closed failures for resume consumers

special_result_interpretations.interpretation: Control result meaning join/wait; must not be mapped to fail-closed API failure by resume bootstrap
Race control token; discard for fail-closed paths

race_applicability.concurrent_invocation: Bootstrap and visibility-resume may overlap on requestHydrate; join in-flight work.
race_applicability.stale_result: Stale generation control results must not fail-close resume startup.
race_applicability.cancellation_skip: Cancelled or superseded hydrate must not leave resume hung without a follow-up entry.
race_applicability.retry_reentry: Retry after control result must re-enter the same coordinator entry, not a parallel path.

lifecycle_applicability.bootstrap: Cold start may join already-running coordinator hydrate.
lifecycle_applicability.already_running: Second entry while in-flight joins; does not start a second GET.
lifecycle_applicability.route_enter_leave: Route leave does not authorize a second hydrate SoT; resume still uses requestHydrate.
lifecycle_applicability.visibility_resume: Visibility resume re-enters via coordinator; joins in-flight when present.
lifecycle_applicability.teardown_remount: Remount after teardown must not leave orphan in-flight flags that block bootstrap join.
